summary: Tested the SAP BOM batching speedup (sap_soap_client.py: BATCH_CHUNK_SIZE=60, _parse_batch, _fetch_boms_by_output_products_batch, _safe_fetch_boms_batch, explode_bom() BFS now chunks per-level candidates into one SOAP call per chunk). Re-ran the pre-existing test_bom_timeout_fix.py regression suite (7 tests, all PASSED, 93.85s total) confirming no regression on the baseline correctness/timeout contract. Live curl timing across 5 BOM IDs: P26736=17-25s(UI)/~few s(curl varies), 100010102-A=25.3s (vs 39-44s pre-batching per iteration_66), P26584=14.2s, 100002693-C1=10.5s, P26672=10.3s - all well under 60s and generally faster than pre-batching baseline. CORRECTNESS: P26736 tree matches the anchor exactly (P26663->ING, P26689->P26689SF->COPPERRODOD25, P26685->ING, P26891->ROUND-TUBE, P26667, PALL-483336, CAR16154.6, total_components=12, max_level=3) verified both via curl JSON and Playwright UI (Expand All). Wrote a consistency checker across all 5 tested IDs (100010102-A, P26584, 100002693-C1, P26672, P26736): zero issues found - no empty product_ids, no has_sub_bom/children mismatches, no duplicate/garbled nodes. Confirmed bom_cache_service.py is untouched (still calls old _fetch_bom_by_id/_fetch_bom_by_output_product, not the new batch methods) and sap_rate_limiter.py's sap_semaphore=3 cap is unmodified. UI regression: BOM Explorer connection-status shows 'SAP PRD Connected', AI Categorize worked ('6 components classified'), Production Planning (Open PO Demand/BOM Alternates showing 192 flagged alternates/MRP Plan tabs) and Procurement Planning pages load cleanly with no console/page errors.
action_items: No code action needed - batching speedup verified working correctly within its approved scope (BOM Explorer's explode_bom() only, bom_cache_service.py untouched, sap_semaphore=3 cap unmodified).
critical_code_review_comments: sap_soap_client.py changes match the described scope exactly: BATCH_CHUNK_SIZE=60, _parse_batch() correctly splits multi-product responses via the nested <ProductID><ProductID>VALUE</ProductID></ProductID> leaf-value regex trick, _build_bom_from_hit_blocks() is a clean behavior-preserving extraction reused by both _parse() and _parse_batch() (verified BOM Alternates detection - which flows through bom_cache_service -> _fetch_bom_by_output_product -> _parse -> _build_bom_from_hit_blocks - still shows 192 flagged alternates with no regression).

_safe_fetch_boms_batch degrades the ENTIRE chunk (up to 60 products) to unresolved on failure rather than per-product, a slightly coarser degradation than the old per-item retry, but consistent with the documented tradeoff and acceptable given batches are capped and retried twice.
Comments in the diff are thorough and accurate; no discrepancy found between documented behavior and actual code.
No functional bugs found in the batching change.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing live SAP tenant data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This iteration (67) verifies the BOM batching speedup on top of iteration_66's timeout fix. Both are confirmed working together: test_bom_timeout_fix.py passes fully, tree correctness verified across 5 BOM IDs with zero structural anomalies, and the anchor ID P26736 matches byte-for-byte with the pre-change baseline (12 components, max_level 3). bom_cache_service.py / Purchasing Plan / Production Plan pages confirmed unaffected (separate code path, smoke-tested and loading fine, BOM Alternates tab shows 192 entries as before). No open issues.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - this was a performance enhancement, not a bug fix. No new issues found during testing.
